content.short: ONE Fight Arena is a mobile match-3 PvP strategy game featuring MMA stars and NFT fighters on the Sui blockchain.
content.description: ONE Fight Arena is a pioneering mobile-native strategy game developed by ONE Championship and Animoca Brands, combining match-3 mechanics with the intensity of mixed martial arts. Built natively on the Sui blockchain, the game features an extensive roster of real-world MMA legends. Players can compete in intense PvP battles and manage their team of fighters within a vibrant virtual world. The platform integrates optional Web3 features, allowing players to mint fighters as NFTs for true ownership. By leveraging Sui's speed, ONE Fight Arena delivers a seamless experience bridging mobile sports and Web3 rewards.
content.meta: ONE Fight Arena offers MMA strategy gaming and NFT-based fighter ownership on the Sui blockchain. Find ONE Fight Arena on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
